name: Cornilescu
statement: This Bible is in the Public Domain.

evidence.quote: Copyright of the Cornilescu Bible © 1924 belongs to British and Foreign Bible Society.
This Bible translation is permanently in the public domain (not copyrighted) due to copyright expiration.

verification.note: The sources disagree: eBible.org calls the 1924 text public domain (for its Cyrillic-script edition), while the British and Foreign Bible Society claims the copyright. Dumitru Cornilescu died in 1975, so under Romanian law (life + 70) the text is protected until 2045.
